primary.$description: Primary action / brand. blue-650 #243EE8 (OKLCH H267°, electric violet-blue). on-primary 7.07:1 AA.

on-primary.$description: Text/icons on primary. paper #FEFDFF on primary → 7.07:1 · AA text ✓ (Sistema contrast API).
